subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned requireMention group messages into a later mentioned turn, and under what bounds?
rationale: The source fix is clear, but it changes a privacy/security boundary: media that did not mention the bot would be stored and later exposed to model context.

options.title: Approve bounded opt-in retention
options.body: Allow Telegram to retain a small, local-image-only, historyLimit-bounded set of unmentioned group media only behind an explicit existing or new ambient-ingest policy.

options.title: Approve default retention
options.body: Treat unmentioned Telegram media like text history by default, accepting a larger privacy and storage footprint.

options.title: Keep current privacy default
options.body: Continue skipping unaddressed group media before download and document that later turns can inspect only addressed or ambient-ingest media.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded opt-in retention
recommendation.body: Allow Telegram to retain a small, local-image-only, historyLimit-bounded set of unmentioned group media only behind an explicit existing or new ambient-ingest policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The current media-skip safety boundary was introduced in the Telegram PR this issue would need to modify.
